test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Intricate
solution: The correct answer is: **Complicated** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Intricate **means having many complexly interrelating parts or elements. (कई जटिल परस्पर संबंधित भागों या तत्वों का होना) • Example -* The watch mechanism is extremely **intricate **and very difficult to understand.* • Marked option **Complicated **means involving a lot of different parts, in a way that is difficult to understand. (बहुत सारे अलग-अलग हिस्सों को एक तरह से शामिल करना, जिसे समझना मुश्किल है) • Example -* The instructions look very **complicated**.* • It is clear that '**Intricate**' and '**Complicated**' are similar in meaning. Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Basic **means forming an essential foundation or starting point; fundamental. (एक आवश्यक नींव या प्रारंभिक बिंदु बनाना; मौलिक) • **Painted **means covered or decorated with paint. (रंग से ढका या सजाया हुआ) • **Developed **means to grow or change into a more advanced, larger, or stronger form. (अधिक उन्नत, बड़े या मजबूत रूप में विकसित या परिवर्तित होना) 44:T912, The correct answer is: **is to go and have **
